//types: `types: ["node"]` is the one departure from every other project here, and it is the opposite of the departure packages/economy, engines/game and engines/diagnostic refuse. They exclude their source-reading sweeps from tsc precisely so that `import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'` CANNOT typecheck inside a package whose contract is zero I/O. This project's contract is the reverse: every file in it opens the repository and reads it, so node:fs is its subject rather than a leak. Scoping is per-project and was measured, not assumed: @types/node sits in the root node_modules and is NOT auto-included anywhere, so a `node:fs` import in packages/economy/src still fails with TS2591.
//noEmit: This project publishes nothing -- no other project references it -- so it emits nothing, and that is load-bearing rather than tidy. `support/repoRoot.test.ts` derives its population by walking `test/` on the FILESYSTEM for *.ts, deliberately rather than through `git ls-files`, so that a sweep is covered from the moment it is saved. Emitting to `test/dist` therefore put seventeen generated .d.ts files into that population and turned its both-ways exemption census red. Gitignoring the output does not help: the walk never asks git.
